exec_place_paths.router: src/pumpgrok/supervisor/intent_router.py: IntentRouter.route calls the injected exec_place once, after RiskEngine.check returns an autonomous_paper approval bound to the ticket, mint and size.
exec_place_paths.other_strategy_path_found: src/pumpgrok/strategies/legacy.py _placement_sink / _place_buy calls trading.place (exec.place) directly for LegacyScreening Intents, bypassing the router. Owned by bot-02-risk (15-03). No production caller found; tests/strategies/test_legacy_parity.py and test_attribution.py call run_legacy_replay. Not edited: outside this plan's file set. Owner decision required (see open_findings).

deviations: Order of checks: the plan lists allocate_ticket, slice check, RiskEngine.check, then the ticket-to-strategy link. The implementation runs allocate, link, slice check, RiskEngine.check, exec.place. The link is written before the slice check so every routed decision is attributed and the link row is the idempotency record.

Constructor: IntentRouter takes two required keyword arguments beyond the plan's (exec_place, risk, store, clock, ids): slices (strategy id to lamport slice, computed by the caller with allocation.slice_lamports) and max_slippage_bps. exec_place is an async callable taking the place payload dict, not PlaceIn.

Atomicity: allocate_ticket appends its own row through append_batch with no sidecar hook, so the ticket row and the link row cannot share one transaction without editing ledger/tickets.py (RISK-owned, out of file set). The link is a separate append_with_ticket_ref transaction immediately after allocation. A crash between the two leaves an unlinked ticket with no order placed.

Idempotency: the link row's key is route|strategy|decision. A second route of the same decision returns status duplicate with the first ticket and never calls exec.place, including when the first attempt was refused after linking.
Refusal reasons added beyond the plan's list: unknown_strategy, approval_mismatch, ticket_allocation_failed, autonomy_manual_ticket (the last is the plan's refusal below autonomous-paper).

Autonomy source: the router reads the level from the ledger (read_autonomy). The RiskEngine's own autonomy constructor argument is separate. A RiskEngine built at manual-ticket returns passed=False (approval_missing), so the router refuses and journals; it cannot place without an approval.

tests/desk/test_ticket_approval_allocation.py duplicates the fakes and helpers of test_intent_router.py instead of importing them, because tests/desk has no package __init__.py and cross-module test imports are not used in this repository.

open_findings: Criterion 11 must-have 'exec.place is reachable for strategy Intents only through the router; no other path exists' is NOT met as the code stands. src/pumpgrok/strategies/legacy.py (15-03, RISK) places LegacyScreening BUY intents through trading.place directly. It is library-only today, with no production caller. Fixing it needs either a bot-02-risk edit to route legacy placement through IntentRouter (which would also refuse replay parity below autonomous-paper, breaking criterion 5), or an owner decision that the legacy replay path is a replay-only exception. Owner decision required.
